notes: [P1] fragile-structure: the 40px HUD bar is drawn over the top of the board (drawFrame paints it after draw). Only the two button rects are hit-tested in src/main.js. A click anywhere else on the bar falls through to placeTower on row 0, and a tower or ghost in that row is partly hidden under the opaque bar. No test covers clicks on the bar outside the buttons, or whether row 0 should be placeable under the HUD.

[P1] unhandled-edge: the keydown handler in src/main.js toggles on every keydown, including auto-repeat (event.repeat is not checked). Holding P or F flips pause or speed many times, so where it stops depends on how long the key was held.

[P1] missing-test: nothing tests the click and keyboard wiring in src/main.js, including that a HUD button click places no tower. Only the pure helpers hudButtonAt and hudButtonForKey are tested; the HUD_ACTIONS dispatch and its early return are not.

[P2] style: in src/render.js the FONT constant sits between WIDTH and HEIGHT, which splits the board dimension pair; and drawPill runs each layout closure twice through a measuring() stand-in, which is harder to follow than measuring the text widths up front.
